description: Read the CSV from a local file or the official Our World in Data URL into a Pandas DataFrame.
Keep only the columns needed for cases, deaths, vaccination, population, and country/date identifiers to reduce noise.
Convert the `date` column to a datetime format so trend plots, rolling averages, and forecasting models work correctly.
Remove duplicate `location` + `date` records to ensure one daily observation per region.
Forward-fill cumulative metrics within each country and replace missing daily metrics with 0 where appropriate.
Create rolling averages, growth rates, per-million indicators, death rate, vaccination shares, and recovery trend proxies.
